findings: Conditional-expression precedence includes the complete import/identity/close block only for early_eof; normal generated child payload is unchanged.
On Windows only the three explicit direct_stdio callers use an absolute existing active CPython sys._base_executable; other cases and all production launch paths are unchanged.
The actual child checks implementation name, major/minor/micro version and sys.maxsize against the parent before closing descriptors.
The ready marker is written and closed as a sibling then atomically replaced, so parent PID parsing cannot observe a just-created empty marker.
WindowsJobProcess uses the existing Popen launcher with native CreateProcess result; its owned leader PID remains the actual process PID. The marker must equal that PID.
Existing child exit, reader drain, pending-owner cleanup, elapsed allowances, assertions and test case count remain.
